text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends a U-turn prohibition on Dean Park Road between Kenscott Road and Braymore Boulevard (east intersection). Prohibiting U-turns will provide a safer environment for all road users along this section of Dean Park Road which is located adjacent to St. Jean de Brebeuf Catholic School and John G. Diefenbaker Public School.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Dean Park Road, between Kenscott Road and Braymore Boulevard (east intersection).
